description: Kindling, Borrowed Torch's game engine: its additional features - sound, post effects, vegetation, fabric, sprites, collisions and culling - for a game's own code to build against beside the engine
Dark theme for Bashka based on Turbo Vision compatible theme.
Subrange types for .NET: a number type that only holds values within its bounds, generated from a [Subrange] declaration, whose only constructor is private so every value has been checked.
Documents Subrange types in Swashbuckle OpenAPI schemas as the integers and numbers they are on the wire, with their minimum and maximum.

FluentValidation integration for ResultUnion: a ValidationResult becomes a Result whose error has one field error per failure (field, code, message, arguments), and IValidator.ValidateToResultAsync returns the validated value as a Result.

.NET binding to the Chromium Embedded Framework C API for Windows and Linux x64: ClangSharp-generated interop and a thin managed layer for windowed and off-screen browsers. CEF itself comes with a CefKit.Runtime.<rid> package.

Reads and writes email, contact and calendar files. Outlook data files (PST and OST, ANSI, Unicode and 4K-page formats, with or without encryption): folders, messages, recipients, attachments, embedded messages, bodies (text, HTML, compressed RTF), MAPI and named properties, contacts, appointments…
